key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：中等、中等、中等、中等

key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 系統架構規劃、軟體程式設計、軟體工程系統開發、模組化系統設計、網頁語法撰寫

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
1. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
2. Good communication and teamwork abilities.
3. Ability to manage time effectively and work independently when needed.
4. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends.
5. Good English reading and communication skills for technical documentation.
--------
Candidates should possess solid experience and proficiency in the following areas:
1. JavaScript (ES6+)
2. HTML5 & CSS3
3. TypeScript
4. React (or similar frontend frameworks)
5. Responsive Web Design principles
6. RESTful API integration
7. Version control using Git
8. Basic understanding of frontend architecture and component-based development
-------
Experience with the following tools or technologies will be considered a strong plus:
1. SASS or other CSS preprocessors
2. AJAX and JSON handling
3. Familiarity with modern frontend build tools and workflows
4. UI/UX awareness and attention to detail
5. Exposure to unit testing or E2E testing in frontend projects
